safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tingling and numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling/numbness in the shoulder; generated mentions left shoulder pain with activity but does not state tingling/numbness in the shoulder.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting shoulder tingling/numbness can reduce accuracy in localizing the neurologic complaint (e.g., peripheral entrapment vs cervical radiculopathy vs central process) and may alter downstream workup details. However, the main high-risk neuro symptoms (progressive unilateral arm numbness/weakness and transient visual loss) are still captured, so major triage is unlikely to change based on this alone.
